title: Build workspace search entries
responsibility: List searchable units for the shown project and revision and resolve only those result objects.

inputs.name: workspaceSearch.shown
inputs.type: { snapshot: ProjectSnapshot | null; pinned: boolean; busy: boolean; }
inputs.description: The view's `snapshot` (null while no project is read) with its `busy` and `pinned` flags. A true `busy` gives no entries and the label 'Reading the project' even when a snapshot is present, and a true `pinned` keeps the revision's full commit in each result's workspace address and its first seven characters in the scope, as a revision that is not at tip already does.

commits.subject: Scope workspace search to the shown revision
Keep pinned commits in workspace routes

entities.title: workspaceSearch
entities.summary: List searchable units for the shown project and revision and resolve only those result objects.
entities.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

outputs.name: workspaceSearch
outputs.description: `entries` holds one entry per entity of the shown revision, each with the full revision commit and no search terms, or null while reading. `scope.label` names the project at the tip of its branch, or at the first seven characters of the commit when that commit is kept (or reads 'Reading the project' while reading), `scope.pinned` is those seven characters or null, and `at` returns a workspace address only for an object taken from `entries` itself whose category is one of the supported categories, otherwise null.
